movies.title: Detour
movies.shortDescription: A down-on-his-luck pianist hitchhikes to Hollywood, assumes a dead man's identity, and spirals into a nightmare of fate and murder.
movies.longDescription: Edgar G. Ulmer's legendary low-budget noir follows Al Roberts, a pianist hitchhiking to Hollywood whose ride ends in accidental death. Taking the dead man's identity to avoid suspicion, he is blackmailed by a ruthless drifter into a spiral of doom. The quintessential fatalistic noir.

movies.title: D.O.A.
movies.shortDescription: Poisoned with a slow-acting toxin, a man has days to live and races to find his own killer before time runs out.
movies.longDescription: Edmond O'Brien stars as Frank Bigelow, a notary who walks into a police station to report a murder - his own. Told he has only days to live after being poisoned, he tears through a shadowy underworld to unmask his killer in this frantic noir classic.

movies.title: Scarlet Street
movies.shortDescription: A meek bank clerk and amateur painter falls for a femme fatale who exploits his art and his heart. Fritz Lang's dark noir masterpiece.
movies.longDescription: Fritz Lang directs Edward G. Robinson as Christopher Cross, a henpecked cashier whose secret paintings catch the eye of a scheming woman and her con-man boyfriend. What begins as infatuation becomes a trap of betrayal, murder, and guilt.

movies.title: The Hitch-Hiker
movies.shortDescription: Two friends on a fishing trip pick up a hitchhiker who turns out to be a wanted killer. Ida Lupino's tense, lean noir.
movies.longDescription: Directed by Ida Lupino - the only woman directing noir in its heyday - this nerve-shredding thriller traps two ordinary men with a remorseless escaped killer in the Mexican desert, where one wrong move means death.

movies.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
movies.shortDescription: A powerful woman's buried secret resurfaces when an old flame returns to town. Starring Barbara Stanwyck and Kirk Douglas.
movies.longDescription: Barbara Stanwyck is Martha Ivers, a ruthless heiress whose teenage crime binds her to a weak husband and a dark past. When an old flame returns, long-buried secrets threaten to destroy them all. Features Kirk Douglas in his screen debut.

movies.title: The Big Combo
movies.shortDescription: An obsessed cop takes on a sadistic crime boss in a brutal game of cat-and-mouse. Stylish, hard-edged noir.
movies.longDescription: Cornel Wilde plays a detective consumed by his pursuit of a vicious mob kingpin, even as he falls for the gangster's moll. Joseph H. Lewis's ultra-stylish noir is famous for its shadows, sadism, and unforgettable climax.

movies.title: The Stranger
movies.shortDescription: A federal agent hunts a Nazi war criminal hiding as a respected professor in a quiet Connecticut town. Orson Welles directs and stars.
movies.longDescription: Orson Welles directs and stars as Franz Kindler, a Nazi war criminal living under an assumed identity as a New England college professor. Federal agent Edward G. Robinson tracks him through a web of lies to a climactic confrontation in the town's clock tower. One of the great postwar noirs.
